sources.title: GitHub - ClaudioSS01/portuguese-Bertimbau: Portuguese pre-trained BERT ...
sources.snippet: This repository contains pre-trained BERT models trained on the Portuguese language. BERT-Base and BERT-Large Cased variants were trained on the BrWaC (Brazilian Web as Corpus), a large Portuguese corpus, for 1,000,000 steps, using whole-word mask.

sources.title: BERTimbau - Diretório de software de IA - megatek.ai
sources.snippet: BERTimbau é um modelo de linguagem pré-treinado baseado na arquitetura transformer BERT, desenvolvido pela NeuralMind e lançado em 2020 com foco exclusivo no português brasileiro.

sources.title: ‎Google Gemini
sources.snippet: O Gemini é IA e pode cometer erros. Conheça o Gemini, o assistente de IA da Google. Receba ajuda para escrever, planear, debater ideias e muito mais. Experimente o poder da IA generativa.

sources.title: neuralmind/bert-base-portuguese-cased · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: BERTimbau Base is a pretrained BERT model for Brazilian Portuguese that achieves state-of-the-art performances on three downstream NLP tasks: Named Entity Recognition, Sentence Textual Similarity and Recognizing Textual Entailment. It is available in two sizes: Base and Large. For further information or requests, please go to BERTimbau repository.
